title: Here's Why This Man Has Been Arrested 37 Times
description:
► If you’re ever injured in an accident, you can check out Morgan & Morgan. You can start your claim in just a click without having to leave your couch. To start your claim, visit: https://www.forthepeople.com/CodeBlueCam?s=86%3A4369

On March 15, 2024, police responded to a disturbance at the probation office in Eau Claire, WI. A man on probation had reportedly charged at probation agents as they arrived for work and was harassing employees from nearby businesses. When police arrived, he started destroying his belongings and provided a few words of discouragement. While in custody, he slammed his head against the police car, causing damage. According to online records, the man has been arrested approximately 37 times since 2003.
